description: This file defines the Profile controller class for the OpenCart admin panel. It manages displaying and saving user profile information, including rendering the profile page with user details and handling profile update requests via AJAX.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Controller class responsible for rendering and processing the user profile page in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the user profile page with user data, including breadcrumbs, user info, and images.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to update the user profile, including validation and permission checks.
